Welcome Back Everyone!We look forward to seeing as many of you as possible at our Welcome Meetings!
Headteacher's Welcome
We are delighted to welcome you to North Heath Community Primary School. Located in North Horsham, we are a busy, happy and high-achieving large primary school. Dedicated to providing a supportive and caring atmosphere, with an emphasis on kindness, creativity and courage, we work hard to make every child feel valued, safe and empowered to succeed.
We believe that nurturing strong partnerships between parents, carers, governors and the local community supports our pupils’ social, emotional and academic development, enabling them to thrive.
It is always a pleasure to introduce new pupils and families to our school. We very much look forward to meeting you.
~ Nicky Chesshire, Headteacher
Tours and Visits
As a thriving community school, we are always pleased to welcome prospective parents and families to North Heath. We are delighted to invite you to join us for a guided tour to find out more about what our school can offer you and your child.
We will hold a Showcase Open Evening on Thursday 8th October from 5:30pm-7:00pm. During this evening, you will be free to wander around our site. All of the classrooms will be open and our friendly staff available to help you to get a flavour of North Heath’s inspiring curriculum and personal approach. The evening will be rounded off with a talk from the Headteacher and Early Years team in the school hall at 6:30pm. It would be lovely if as many as possible could join us for this.
There are also a range of dates for small group daytime tours of the school. These will consist of an opportunity to see us in action with various teaching and learning activities as well as a sit-down chat with the Headteacher and Assistant Headteacher (Early Years & Foundation Stage lead).
Children are always welcome to these events – we want them to see their new school and feel part of the community!
Please call the school office on 01403 254790 or email office@northheathprimary.co.uk to book a date that is most convenient to you. Additional dates could be offered if none are suitable.
Tours are available on each of the following dates:
October: Monday 12th (2pm), Wednesday 14th (10am), Friday 16th (10am), Monday 19th (10am), Wednesday 21st (10am), and Thursday 22nd (2pm).
November: Tuesday 3rd (10am & 2pm), Thursday 5th (10am & 2pm), Monday 9th (10am), Wednesday 11th (2pm), Friday 13th (10am), and Wednesday 18th (10am).
We look forward to meeting you and showing you everything North Heath has to offer.

Governors
Amy Green
Amy was a parent to two children who both attended North Heath. She has been Finance Chair and Co Chair and served for the past five years.
As a Chartered insurance broker who is based in London, but delivers solutions to large corporate business all over the UK, Amy brings business specialism and financial experience. In her day job the focus is managing risks, financial review, procurement and specialist insurance products.
Amy is a former President of the Insurance Institute of Sussex and currently leads for business engagement on the Institute council, A London Livery Woman with The Worshipful Company of Constructors and a council member of the London Chamber of Commerce and Industry, serving on the ESG and Fraud and Security committees.
Amy is a grant committee member of the UK Insurance Charities, a benevolent fund for those working in the industry
In her spare time Amy supports her children and their team at Atlantis swimming club and walks to the pub and beach with her husband.
Claire Coles
I am delighted to have been elected as Co-Chair of Governors for the school for a second year. My daughter is in Year 4 at the school and from the time she started I wanted to be able to support – initially as a member of Friends of North Heath, and more recently as a member of the Governing body. My professional career started with my MSc in forensic psychology and has been one of working in the statutory and charity sectors in the field of safeguarding and public protection as a Probation Officer, Local Authority Designated Officer, Faith Case Review Project Manager and Advisor. I currently work as the Methodist South East District Safeguarding Officer and alongside this deliver safeguarding training. I’m passionate about children feeling safe and being able to thrive and with this in mind, I also became a member of the West Sussex Children and Young People Scrutiny Committee. I believe that the relationship we have as parents, with our children’s school, is vital for them to be able to flourish.
Mrs Kennedy

Mrs Hope

Clubs
Summer Term 2026
In the Summer Term, there are a number of extra-curricular clubs taking place after school. Internally-led clubs are run by staff on a voluntary basis – there is no charge for these clubs and we are extremely grateful that our teachers are willing to give up their time to run them.
When: From Monday 27 April until Friday 19 June 2026Time: 3.15pm to 4.00pm
Clubs WILL NOT RUN on Monday 4 May as it is a Bank Holiday or on Monday 1 June as it is an Inset Day.
If selected for a club, pupils are expected to attend all sessions unless they are absent or parents have emailed the teacher leading the club or the office; a register will be taken. In the event of bad weather, outdoor clubs will take place indoors.
School Council Meetings: will be held on a Monday after school 3.15pm – 4.00pm during the weeks in which internal clubs are held. If your child has been elected as school council for their class, they are expected to continue to attend these meetings all year. This will not affect their ability to join another club on a different day.
Homework Clubs:Weekly attendance is not essential for Homework Club. However, pupils gain most from the club through regular attendance so this is preferable. The club will be available for up to 30 pupils to support them with their learning.
Year 3 & 4 Homework Club: will run from 3.15pm to 4.00pm starting Thursday 23 April 2026 until Thursday 9 July 2026.
Year 5 & 6 Homework Club: will run from 3.15pm to 4.00pm starting Thursday 23 April 2026 until Thursday 9 July 2026.
Please note:Year 5 & 6 Homework Club will NOT run on Thursday 14th May 2026.
Clubs will run, whatever the weather. In the event of bad weather, outdoor clubs will take place indoors.
External Clubs:A range of clubs run by external providers are on offer during the Summer Term. Places for these clubs need to be booked directly with the providers. All details can be found at the end of this letter.

At North Heath Primary, our curriculum is designed to foster a lifelong love of learning and empower every child to reach their full potential.
